chapter: England, later career and closing thoughts
title: Honolulu by ship, closing thanks
summary: She mentions going to Honolulu by ship, says she would choose music again, and thanks the Smithsonian; Willard closes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And of course when I went to Honolulu later, I also went by ship. I went on the -- no, I went on a small ship and came back on the Lurlean which was a very famous ship at that time, you know. But all in all it was wonderful having travelled around, having met many wonderful people in my career, and I still think if I had to choose another profession I would

not have chosen anything else. I would still be a musician, an entertainer, because I love people and I love the scene, and again, I do want to thank the Smithsonian people for allowing Nellie Lutcher to be a part of your -- what do you call it?
Oral history program. Thank you so very much.
